performance.method: 30 actual native nextDay calls, identical Day 751 input, seed 42, mixed policy, VM clock, jsdom. Each comparison ran separately. Includes the base engine and mod, not browser rendering. CPU-profiled final release run.
performance.limits: Small observational samples on one host with varying load. Earlier v1.6.94 runs measured median 256/257 ms; final run 305 ms. These are not FPS, input latency or guaranteed savings.

oldSaveTerritoryCopies.scope: Compressed input keys decoded using its codes table. This field total is not a claim about the whole new save size.

browserCpuThrottle.limits: One real browser turn with simulated CPU throttling. Includes UI inspection overhead. No physical slow device or browser FPS claim.

desktop.note: Native desktop page retains a 3px document-width excess. The decision panel fits.

documentation.liveReadmeRendering: Not yet checked for this release.

dependencies.runtimeDelivery: One independently installable classic script. Existing engine assets supply icons and fonts. jsdom remains development-only.

remainingLimits: Human pacing and enjoyment still need playtesting.
Real shortages, missing local methods or unavailable workers can leave long-running work unfinished. No free completion was inserted.
The CPU-throttled browser check is one simulated slow-CPU turn, not a physical low-end-device matrix.
Existing native proposals still use their event-specific lapse rules and do not retain executable choice callbacks across page reload.

publication.status: Prepared and locally verified. CDN readback pending.
